7230.title: Live ACP forks cross the owning process
7230.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge sends session/fork through a newly spawned target connection instead of the live source connection, bypassing process-local ownership and quiescence.

prReviews.topFinding: Method-order test does not enforce per-process ownership or cover failed target restore.

7230.proposedFix: Use owner-process fork, release only the fork, then restore in the target; keep handoff restore errors fatal.
7230.caveats: Bridge ownership rejection reproduced in two trusted checkouts; Kimi and side-chat HTTP behavior not tested. Open linked PR #7231 prevents a duplicate fix. Reproduction patch and output are inline under reports repository policy.
